S.FORM: tee=ku pu-a-iisua sua t<in>uturu=cu=maku chiausou=maku.
S.PHON: teeku puaiisua sua tinuturuʦumaku ʦhiausoumaku
S.FORM: teeku puaiisua sua t<in>uturucumaku chiausoumaku.
S.PHON: teeku puaiisua sua tinutu[r|ɾ]uʦumaku ʦhiausoumaku
S.TRANSL: I'll tell my professor a story.

S.FORM: kisa-i ma-maaraŋ taa-ʔaratiŋ-a.
S.PHON: kisai mamaaraŋ taaʔaratiŋa
S.FORM: kisai mamaarang taa'aratinga.
S.PHON: kisai mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ taaʔa[r|ɾ]atiŋa
S.TRANSL: It's what old people call a "narrow stream in a valley."

S.FORM: sua taa-ʔaratiŋ-a kisa-ən ia, ʔakia taavalaʔə kaa-taərəpə ʔinia si cu-cculu ni-ala-tumulu tatia.
S.PHON: sua taaʔaratiŋa kisaən ia ʔakia taavaɾaʔə kaataərəpə ʔinia ʂi ʦuʦʦuɾu niaɾatumuɾu tatia
S.FORM: sua taa'aratinga kisaen ia, 'akia taavara'e kaataerepe 'inia si cuccuru niaratumuru tatia.
S.PHON: sua taaʔa[r|ɾ]atiŋa kisaen ia ʔakia taava[r|ɾ]aʔe kaatae[r|ɾ]epe ʔinia ʂi ʦuʦʦu[r|ɾ]u nia[r|ɾ]atumu[r|ɾ]u tatia
S.TRANSL: It is said no one could dive into the place "narrow stream" because there is really a lot (of water).

S.FORM: mata kaʔan u-cani maamia, ni-ala-tumul-a ʔinia.
S.PHON: mata kaʔan uʦani maamia niaɾatumuɾa ʔinia
S.FORM: mata ka'an ucani maamia, niaratumura 'inia.
S.PHON: mata kaʔan uʦani maamia nia[r|ɾ]atumu[r|ɾ]a ʔinia
S.TRANSL: Only this one could not be reached because there was too much water there.

S.FORM: nain vanai-ni kanakanavu miana ma-ʔanman kaa-taərəpə ʔinia?
S.PHON: nain vanaini kanakanavu miana maʔanman kaataərəpə ʔinia
S.FORM: nain vanaini kanakanavu miana ma'anman kaataerepe 'inia?
S.PHON: nain vanaini kanakanavu miana maʔanman kaatae[r|ɾ]epe ʔinia
S.TRANSL: What's the reason Kanakanavu people would like to get there by diving?

S.FORM: sua talaku iisua ia, makai puuŋaana, makasua makai puuŋaana.
S.PHON: sua taɾaku iisua ia makai puuŋaana makasua makai puuŋaana
S.FORM: sua taraku iisua ia, makai puungaana, makasua makai puungaana.
S.PHON: sua ta[r|ɾ]aku iisua ia makai puuŋaana makasua makai puuŋaana
S.TRANSL: The cave looks like a water vat.

S.FORM: ta-skar-a ʔinia ia, makai denki ma-ciasə, makai deŋki m-uru-sinaŋ.
S.PHON: taskara ʔinia ia makai *enki matʂiasə makai *eŋki muruʂinaŋ
S.FORM: taskara 'inia ia, makai denki maciase, makai dengki murusinang.
S.PHON: taska[r|ɾ]a ʔinia ia makai *enki matʂiase makai *eŋki mu[r|ɾ]uʂinaŋ
S.TRANSL: In the depths of the water, it is so bright and shiny, as if there is electricity.

S.FORM: nain vanai-n ma-maa-maraŋ ma-ʔanman mu-kusa ʔinia?
S.PHON: nain vanain mamaamaraŋ maʔanman mukusa ʔinia
S.FORM: nain vanain mamaamarang ma'anman mukusa 'inia?
S.PHON: nain vanain mamaama[r|ɾ]aŋ maʔanman mukusa ʔinia
S.TRANSL: What's the reason the elder people would like to go there?

S.FORM: nu tuncu-nni ia, ʔaravaŋ iisua ia, maka-sia lun-cala na ni-ru-camu-a sua ʔaapana.
S.PHON: nu tunʦunni ia ʔaravaŋ iisua ia makaʂia ɾunʦaɾa na niruʦamua sua ʔaapana
S.FORM: nu tuncunni ia, 'aravang iisua ia, makasia runcara na nirucamua sua 'aapana.
S.PHON: nu tunʦunni ia ʔa[r|ɾ]avaŋ iisua ia makaʂia [r|ɾ]unʦa[r|ɾ]a na ni[r|ɾ]uʦamua sua ʔaapana
S.TRANSL: If fish poison is put into (the narrow stream), there will be a big pile of fish, named 'aapana in Kanakanavu.

S.FORM: in-maamia kanakanavu taavalaʔə kaa-taərəpə ʔinia ia, tee=maku a-pa-taa-ŋanai-ni ʔaapana.
S.PHON: inmaamia kanakanavu taavaɾaʔə kaataərəpə ʔinia ia teemaku apataaŋanaini ʔaapana
S.FORM: inmaamia kanakanavu taavara'e kaataerepe 'inia ia, teemaku apataanganaini 'aapana.
S.PHON: inmaamia kanakanavu taava[r|ɾ]aʔe kaatae[r|ɾ]epe ʔinia ia teemaku apataaŋanaini ʔaapana
S.TRANSL: Only the ones who can dive there, they will be named 'aapana.

S.FORM: ma-maaraŋ=mita miana kaa-taərəpə ʔinia ia, ŋanai-n ia, ʔaapana.
S.PHON: mamaaraŋmita miana kaataərəpə ʔinia ia ŋanain ia ʔaapana
S.FORM: mamaarangmita miana kaataerepe 'inia ia, nganain ia, 'aapana.
S.PHON: mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋmita miana kaatae[r|ɾ]epe ʔinia ia ŋanain ia ʔaapana
S.TRANSL: The people who could dive there were named 'aapana in the past.

S.FORM: tee=maku a-pa-taa-ŋanai-n avinaʔu, aapiau, muupaani, ta-tulu maamia.
S.PHON: teemaku apataaŋanain avinaʔu aapiau muupaani tatuɾu maamia
S.FORM: teemaku apataanganain avina'u, aapiau, muupaani, taturu maamia.
S.PHON: teemaku apataaŋanain avinaʔu aapiau muupaani tatu[r|ɾ]u maamia
S.TRANSL: The name of the three people who got there were: Avina'u, Aapiau, and Muupaani.

S.FORM: sua sa-səpat-ini ia, iiku, nakai ni-maka-pusa-n=ku maamia mati-pa ʔinia.
S.PHON: sua sasəpatini ia iiku nakai nimakapusanku maamia matipa ʔinia
S.FORM: sua sasepatini ia, iiku, nakai nimakapusanku maamia matipa 'inia.
S.PHON: sua sasepatini ia iiku nakai nimakapusanku maamia matipa ʔinia
S.TRANSL: I was the fourth person (who dived there), and I (dived there) only twice.

S.FORM: maka-sua sua kanakanavu ni-mu-sikarə ʔinia.
S.PHON: makasua sua kanakanavu nimuʂikarə ʔinia
S.FORM: makasua sua kanakanavu nimusikare 'inia.
S.PHON: makasua sua kanakanavu nimuʂika[r|ɾ]e ʔinia
S.TRANSL: Kanakanavu people got inside there in that way.

S.FORM: sua makai iikia maŋ-təʔai ŋisaa mu-sikar-a-ini ʔinia ia, kaʔan taavalaʔə pu-aiʔi ta-skaar-a.
S.PHON: sua makai iikia maŋtəʔai ŋisaa muʂikaraini ʔinia ia kaʔan taavaɾaʔə puaiʔi taskaara
S.FORM: sua makai iikia mangte'ai ngisaa musikaraini 'inia ia, ka'an taavara'e puai'i taskaara.
S.PHON: sua makai iikia maŋteʔai ŋisaa muʂika[r|ɾ]aini ʔinia ia kaʔan taava[r|ɾ]aʔe puaiʔi taskaa[r|ɾ]a
S.TRANSL: If anyone with a low lung capacity like me (dives) into there, he cannot return.

S.FORM: nuu tee=pu-aiʔi ia, nuu kaa=kia saihu ia, pu-tairi na talaku.
S.PHON: nuu teepuaiʔi ia nuu kaakia saihu ia putairi na taɾaku
S.FORM: nuu teepuai'i ia, nuu kaakia saihu ia, putairi na taraku.
S.PHON: nuu teepuaiʔi ia nuu kaakia saihu ia putai[r|ɾ]i na ta[r|ɾ]aku
S.TRANSL: When I want to return, if I'm not a specialist, I may just kick the empty space of the cave.

S.FORM: kaʔan taavalaʔə pu-aiʔi, tia=mu-a-ʔuna macai.
S.PHON: kaʔan taavaɾaʔə puaiʔi tiamuaʔuna maʦai
S.FORM: ka'an taavara'e puai'i, tiamua'una macai.
S.PHON: kaʔan taava[r|ɾ]aʔe puaiʔi tiamuaʔuna maʦai
S.TRANSL: (I) won't be able to return and will die.

S.FORM: nuu kaa=kia pu-tairi ia, tia=kia mu-a-ʔuna ʔinia macai.
S.PHON: nuu kaakia putairi ia tiakia muaʔuna ʔinia maʦai
S.FORM: nuu kaakia putairi ia, tiakia mua'una 'inia macai.
S.PHON: nuu kaakia putai[r|ɾ]i ia tiakia muaʔuna ʔinia maʦai
S.TRANSL: If I don't keep kicking the empty space of the cave, I'll stay there and die.

S.FORM: tuturu-ai ʔikua chiausou=maku, pu-kari-kari-au misai.
S.PHON: tuturuai ʔikua ʦhiausoumaku pukarikariau misai
S.FORM: tuturuai 'ikua chiausoumaku, pukarikariau misai.
S.PHON: tutu[r|ɾ]uai ʔikua ʦhiausoumaku puka[r|ɾ]ika[r|ɾ]iau misai
S.TRANSL: I'm telling the professor this. Please tell it (to other people).

S.FORM: ʔuuna=kan vaivi ʔinia takis-pintungsien c<in-m>əʔəra ʔinia vənai.
S.PHON: ʔuunakan vaivi ʔinia takispintun*ʂien tʂinməʔəra ʔinia vənai
S.FORM: 'uunakan vaivi 'inia takispintungsien c<inm>e'era 'inia venai.
S.PHON: ʔuunakan vaivi ʔinia takispintuŋʂien tʂinmeʔe[r|ɾ]a ʔinia venai
S.TRANSL: The Paiwan saw a snake there.

S.FORM: kan manaasə t<in>mana=cu=kamu kaari iisi.
S.PHON: kan manaasə tinmanaʦukamu kaari iiʂi
S.FORM: kan manaase t<in>manacukamu kaari iisi.
S.PHON: kan manaase tinmanaʦukamu kaa[r|ɾ]i iiʂi
S.TRANSL: You certainly have heard of the story.

S.FORM: c<əm>əʔəra ʔinia vaivi vənai.
S.PHON: ʦəməʔəra ʔinia vaivi vənai
S.FORM: c<em>e'era 'inia vaivi venai.
S.PHON: ʦemeʔe[r|ɾ]a ʔinia vaivi venai
S.TRANSL: The Paiwan saw a snake there.

S.FORM: cəʔəra-i=kan ʔinia vənai mu-a-para ŋə-ŋəcal-a rəmər-a. tara-kusa maamia ʔinia.
S.PHON: ʦəʔəraikan ʔinia vənai muapara ŋəŋəʦaɾa rəməra tarakusa maamia ʔinia
S.FORM: ce'eraikan 'inia venai muapara ngengecara remera. tarakusa maamia 'inia.
S.PHON: ʦeʔe[r|ɾ]aikan ʔinia venai muapa[r|ɾ]a ŋeŋeʦa[r|ɾ]a [r|ɾ]eme[r|ɾ]a ta[r|ɾ]akusa maamia ʔinia
S.TRANSL: He saw a snake climbing up to the bush. He just looked at it there.

S.FORM: ʔaisi=cu mu-a-sikarə tantanau vənai. a-lala-ʔunsu=kani sua vənai.
S.PHON: ʔaiʂiʦu muaʂikarə tantanau vənai aɾaɾaʔunsukani sua vənai
S.FORM: 'aisicu muasikare tantanau venai. arara'unsukani sua venai.
S.PHON: ʔaiʂiʦu muaʂika[r|ɾ]e tantanau venai a[r|ɾ]a[r|ɾ]aʔunsukani sua venai
S.TRANSL: The snake was (climbing) up the mountain and disappeared.

S.FORM: mu-caan sua vaivi iisua mu-kusa taanaasa.
S.PHON: muʦaan sua vaivi iisua mukusa taanaasa
S.FORM: mucaan sua vaivi iisua mukusa taanaasa.
S.PHON: muʦaan sua vaivi iisua mukusa taanaasa
S.TRANSL: The Paiwan returned home.

S.FORM: t<um>u-tuuturu=kani caau "c<əm>əʔəra=ku vənai a-ma-laucu, t<um>a-tamparu tatia ma-caasə."
S.PHON: tumutuuturukani ʦaau ʦəməʔəraku vənai amaɾauʦu tumatamparu tatia maʦaasə
S.FORM: t<um>utuuturukani caau "c<em>e'eraku venai amaraucu, t<um>atamparu tatia macaase."
S.PHON: tumutuutu[r|ɾ]ukani ʦaau ʦemeʔe[r|ɾ]aku venai ama[r|ɾ]auʦu tumatampa[r|ɾ]u tatia maʦaase
S.TRANSL: He told other people, "I saw a terrifyingly big and long snake downstream."

S.FORM: si-pusa-n sua vaivi c<in-m>əʔəra ia, ni-macai, ni-ara-aka.
S.PHON: ʂipusan sua vaivi tʂinməʔəra ia nimaʦai niaraaka
S.FORM: sipusan sua vaivi c<inm>e'era ia, nimacai, niaraaka.
S.PHON: ʂipusan sua vaivi tʂinmeʔe[r|ɾ]a ia nimaʦai nia[r|ɾ]aaka
S.TRANSL: Two days later, the Paiwan who saw (the snake) died.

S.FORM: sua vənai ia, ʔais=cu apunuunaŋ misai caau.
S.PHON: sua vənai ia ʔaisʦu apunuunaŋ misai ʦaau
S.FORM: sua venai ia, 'aiscu apunuunang misai caau.
S.PHON: sua venai ia ʔaisʦu apunuunaŋ misai ʦaau
S.TRANSL: People said the snake was a devil.

S.FORM: ma-naasə ʔaisi mu-a-ʔuna na ta-ka-taərəp-a kanakanavu pa-ʔaratiŋ-a.
S.PHON: manaasə ʔaiʂi muaʔuna na takataərəpa kanakanavu paʔaratiŋa
S.FORM: manaase 'aisi mua'una na takataerepa kanakanavu pa'aratinga.
S.PHON: manaase ʔaiʂi muaʔuna na takatae[r|ɾ]epa kanakanavu paʔa[r|ɾ]atiŋa
S.TRANSL: (The snake) lived at the narrow stream (with deep water) where the Kanakanavu dived.

S.FORM: sua ta-ʔaratiŋ-a ia, ʔakia ŋanai-n.
S.PHON: sua taʔaratiŋa ia ʔakia ŋanain
S.FORM: sua ta'aratinga ia, 'akia nganain.
S.PHON: sua taʔa[r|ɾ]atiŋa ia ʔakia ŋanain
S.TRANSL: There is no name for the narrow stream.

S.FORM: ni-pa-pa-ta-ŋanai ma-maaraŋ miana ta-ʔaratiŋ-a misai.
S.PHON: nipapataŋanai mamaaraŋ miana taʔaratiŋa misai
S.FORM: nipapatanganai mamaarang miana ta'aratinga misai.
S.PHON: nipapataŋanai mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ miana taʔa[r|ɾ]atiŋa misai
S.TRANSL: The elders in the past simply called it Ta'aratinga.

S.FORM: ʔakia maamia caan, ʔakia maica ʔinia.
S.PHON: ʔakia maamia ʦaan ʔakia maiʦa ʔinia
S.FORM: 'akia maamia caan, 'akia maica 'inia.
S.PHON: ʔakia maamia ʦaan ʔakia maiʦa ʔinia
S.TRANSL: There was no path, and no one could get there.

S.FORM: vanai-n taa-ʔaratiŋ-a kisa-ən ma-maaraŋ miana, ʔakia ta-paica-a ʔinia.
S.PHON: vanain taaʔaratiŋa kisaən mamaaraŋ miana ʔakia tapaiʦaa ʔinia
S.FORM: vanain taa'aratinga kisaen mamaarang miana, 'akia tapaicaa 'inia.
S.PHON: vanain taaʔa[r|ɾ]atiŋa kisaen mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ miana ʔakia tapaiʦaa ʔinia
S.TRANSL: This is the reason why the elders in the past called it Ta'aratinga and there was no path to get there.

S.FORM: makaa-sua sua si-a-tuuturu kamua masi-taavalaʔə=cu=kamu.
S.PHON: makaasua sua ʂiatuuturu kamua maʂitaavaɾaʔəʦukamu
S.FORM: makaasua sua siatuuturu kamua masitaavara'ecukamu.
S.PHON: makaasua sua ʂiatuutu[r|ɾ]u kamua maʂitaava[r|ɾ]aʔeʦukamu
S.TRANSL: I'm telling you for you to know this.

S.FORM: pa-cəp-cəpəŋ-a maamia ʔinaanu sua ta-ʔaratiŋ-a misai.
S.PHON: paʦəpʦəpəŋa maamia ʔinaanu sua taʔaratiŋa misai
S.FORM: pacepcepenga maamia 'inaanu sua ta'aratinga misai.
S.PHON: paʦepʦepeŋa maamia ʔinaanu sua taʔa[r|ɾ]atiŋa misai
S.TRANSL: Try to think just where Ta'aratinga is.

S.FORM: naatia uulu-n pakisia miana.
S.PHON: naatia uuɾun pakiʂia miana
S.FORM: naatia uurun pakisia miana.
S.PHON: naatia uu[r|ɾ]un pakiʂia miana
S.TRANSL: The Chinese people were to block the narrow stream in the past.

S.FORM: kaʔan tavaalaʔ-ən=kiai um-uulu si ma-ʔintasə canumu.
S.PHON: kaʔan tavaaɾaʔənkiai umuuɾu ʂi maʔintasə ʦanumu
S.FORM: ka'an tavaara'enkiai umuuru si ma'intase canumu.
S.PHON: kaʔan tavaa[r|ɾ]aʔenkiai umuu[r|ɾ]u ʂi maʔintase ʦanumu
S.TRANSL: They were not able to block it because the water was very strong.

S.FORM: ŋuaci.
S.PHON: ŋuatʂi
S.FORM: nguaci.
S.PHON: ŋuatʂi
S.TRANSL: That's all.

S.FORM: ara-siŋsiŋ-a, susumanpai.
S.PHON: araʂiŋʂiŋa susumanpai
S.FORM: arasingsinga, susumanpai.
S.PHON: a[r|ɾ]aʂiŋʂiŋa susumanpai
S.TRANSL: Stay healthy! Thank you.
